<script>
(function(){
var c=document.getElementById('cover'),a=document.getElementById('aud'),m=document.getElementById('mus');
var has=typeof AUDIO_B64==='string'&&AUDIO_B64.length>0;
function load(){if(a.getAttribute('src'))return;try{var s=atob(AUDIO_B64),n=s.length,u=new Uint8Array(n);for(var i=0;i<n;i++)u[i]=s.charCodeAt(i);a.src=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([u],{type:'audio/mpeg'}));}catch(e){a.src='data:audio/mpeg;base64,'+AUDIO_B64;}a.load();}
a.addEventListener('error',function(){if(a.src.indexOf('data:')!==0){a.src='data:audio/mpeg;base64,'+AUDIO_B64;a.play().catch(function(){});}});
if(has)m.classList.add('on');
document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
document.getElementById('open').addEventListener('click',function(){
  c.classList.add('gone');document.body.style.overflow='';
  if(has){load();a.play().catch(function(){m.style.opacity=.5});}
});
m.addEventListener('click',function(){
  if(has)load();if(a.paused){a.play().catch(function(){});m.style.opacity=1}else{a.pause();m.style.opacity=.5}
});
function updateCountdown(){
  var target=new Date(2027,2,13,14,0,0).getTime();
  var diff=Math.max(0,target-Date.now());
  var days=Math.floor(diff/86400000); diff%=86400000;
  var hours=Math.floor(diff/3600000); diff%=3600000;
  var minutes=Math.floor(diff/60000); diff%=60000;
  var seconds=Math.floor(diff/1000);
  var values={ 'cd-days':String(days), 'cd-hours':String(hours).padStart(2,'0'), 'cd-minutes':String(minutes).padStart(2,'0'), 'cd-seconds':String(seconds).padStart(2,'0') };
  Object.keys(values).forEach(function(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.textContent=values[id];});
  if(target<=Date.now()){var label=document.querySelector('.countdown .label');if(label)label.textContent='Aujourd’hui, c’est le grand jour !';}
}
updateCountdown();setInterval(updateCountdown,1000);
})();
</script>
